Degree / Course: Undergraduate Degrees (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.Voc., Integrated B.A.-LL.B., Integrated M.Sc.)
Minimum Educational Qualification: Passed Class 12 or equivalent qualifying examination from a recognized central or state school board
Age Criterion: No Age Limit for appearing in CUET (UG) (Candidates must fulfill individual university/institution age requirements)
Admitting Institutes & Scope: Over 250+ Universities including 45+ Central Universities (Delhi University, BHU, JNU, Jamia Millia Islamia, AMU, Allahabad University, etc.) and participating State/Deemed/Private Universities
Counseling & Seat Allocation Mechanism: Decentralized / Respective University CSAS / Samarth portal online admissions based on normalized NTA CUET (UG) percentile scores
